description: This file implements thread-local storage management for TorchDispatch modes in PyTorch, including stack operations, mode setting/unsetting, and utility functions within the c10::impl namespace.

classes.name: TorchDispatchModeTLS
classes.description: Manages thread-local storage for TorchDispatch modes, including stack operations, mode setting/unsetting, and retrieval.

methods.name: any_modes_set
methods.description: Checks if any modes are currently set, optionally skipping infrastructure modes.

methods.name: push_non_infra_mode_onto_stack
methods.description: Pushes a non-infra mode onto the mode stack.

methods.name: pop_stack
methods.description: Pops the top mode from the stack, considering infra modes if stack is empty.

methods.name: pop_highest_infra_mode
methods.description: Removes and returns the highest priority infra mode.

methods.name: get_stack_at
methods.description: Retrieves the mode at a specific index in the combined stack and infra modes.

methods.name: stack_len
methods.description: Returns the total number of modes in the stack and infra modes.

methods.name: get_mode
methods.description: Gets the current mode for a given mode key.

methods.name: set_mode
methods.description: Sets a mode for a specific mode key.

methods.name: unset_mode
methods.description: Unsets the mode for a specific mode key.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current thread-local mode state.
